verification_basis: official public internet sources; source-authority confidence only, not parcel numeric confidence

candidates.name: Index map: official search (PG10) - publication page
verified_facts: Official PG10 publication page was updated 20 July 2026.
The update notes a change in practice intended to reduce SIM application rejections caused by mismatch between a shapefile and the SIM plan.
semantic_limits: Current SIM practice is identification/search evidence, not exact legal-boundary or terrain evidence.
A shapefile accepted for search does not become a survey-grade parcel boundary.

candidates.name: HM Land Registry plans: title plan (PG40s5) - publication page
verified_facts: Official title-plan guide publication page was updated 13 July 2026.
HM Land Registry states the title plan is one of three elements of a registered title and must be read with the register and filed documents.
semantic_limits: Publication freshness does not convert a general boundary into an exact boundary.
Title-plan documentary status is independent of LiDAR vertical accuracy.

candidates.name: HM Land Registry plans: boundaries (PG40s3) - publication page
verified_facts: Official boundary-guide publication page was updated 1 June 2026.
The guide covers general boundaries, ownership and maintenance and routes exact-boundary questions to the determined-boundary framework.
semantic_limits: Boundary-law guidance is horizontal/legal context, not a vertical terrain measurement.

candidates.name: Get information about property and land - Search the register
verified_facts: GOV.UK describes the title plan as showing property location and general boundaries, with exact boundaries usually not recorded.
It distinguishes online copies from official copies used where legal proof is required.
semantic_limits: Register/title-plan retrieval does not prove a determined exact boundary.
Document evidential status must not be converted into terrain confidence.

candidates.name: HM Land Registry portal: request a search of the index map
verified_facts: The portal workflow requires property information and can use an attached plan to define the search area.
The service returns index-map search results rather than a terrain measurement.
semantic_limits: Portal workflow success is not proof of exact parcel geometry.
Search-area plans remain legal/discovery inputs, not DTM observations.

candidates.name: HM Land Registry: illustrative plans
verified_facts: Illustrative plans show how title numbers revealed by an index-map search relate to each other on Ordnance Survey mapping.
They are produced at stated mapping scales for visual interpretation.
semantic_limits: Illustrative plans are relationship/visualisation products and must not be used as exact title extents.
Their map scale is not terrain-height accuracy.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 GeoPackage
verified_facts: OS Terrain 50 contours are supplied as a single national GeoPackage.
The GeoPackage contains contour_line, spot_height and land_water_boundary layers.
semantic_limits: GeoPackage packaging does not create independent measurements.
Contour and spot-height layers remain coarse secondary evidence, not the primary EA DTM1m parcel source.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 vector tiles
verified_facts: OS Terrain 50 contour layers are available as a national MBTiles vector-tile set.
The vector tiles use Web Mercator EPSG:3857 and map attributes only at specified zoom levels.
semantic_limits: Web-Mercator tiled portrayal must not replace native British National Grid numeric sampling.
Zoom-level inclusion is rendering/delivery behaviour, not vertical accuracy.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 Known Data Issues
verified_facts: The official known-data-issues page reports no live known issues at verification time.
Resolved issues remain documented until the next product release.
semantic_limits: No listed live issue does not prove parcel-specific accuracy or survey lineage.
Known-issue status cannot override the coarse 50m secondary role of Terrain 50.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 Known Data Issues
verified_facts: The official known-data-issues page reports no live known issues for OS Terrain 5 at verification time.
The page is the OS route for tracking product-specific known issues between releases.
semantic_limits: No live known issue does not make Terrain 5 the primary parcel source.
OS Terrain 5 remains a secondary cross-check against Environment Agency DTM1m.
